## Conventions learned (Phase 0.3)
- Same as P16.1: uv workspace; `make check` = lint(ruff)+format-check+typecheck(mypy strict)+pytest+verify-gen.
- Part VI `tasks` package = pure in-memory Python engine (StrEnum vocab, frozen dataclasses), data in TOML via `tasks._data.load_table`. Tests tests/tasks/test_tasks_*.py.
- ADRs are SEQUENTIAL in repo (next = ADR-055), NOT the spec Appendix-F number. Spec calls this "ADR-017"; repo ADR-017 is taken (FastAPI). → create ADR-055, note it records the spec's Appendix-F ADR-017 concept (§35.2). Needs "## Revisit trigger". Add row to docs/adr/README.md.
- Governance prose docs/governance/*.md + README index. traceability docs/traceability.md (per-phase Requirement|Where|Test tables). risk register docs/risk_register.md (per-phase sections).
- SPDX header block on every source file.

## Existing surfaces to build against (from exploration)
- policy/rights.py::RightsRecord(source_id, spdx, attribution, redistributable, derivative_permitted, terms_url, retrieval_date, ai_training_permitted, upstream_license). `derivative_permitted` exists, currently unused by any gate.
- policy/licensing.py: effective_license, compute_export_license, most_permissive_license, downstream_obligations; data in policy/data/licenses.toml (relicensable_to lists; ODbL-1.0 relicensable_to=[ODbL-1.0]; CC-BY-SA-4.0 SA→only itself; CC0 relicensable to all; CC-BY-4.0→only itself). Compartments osm_physical(ODbL) + PRE-SEEDED osm_contribution(CC0-1.0) unused.
- connectors/osm.py stamps ODbL-1.0/osm_physical. connectors/registry.py SourceRecord.rights. sources.toml osm_overpass rights derivative_permitted=true.
- api: EntityResponse + /resolution already carry attribution: list[Attribution] via attribution_for(store.rights_for(source_ids)). ClaimResponse has source_id only, NO attribution (gap for 020). api/models.py::Attribution, LicenseStatement. store.rights_for((source_ids)).
- exports: every row stamped `_rights` = downstream_obligations(...) (names upstream). So exports already name upstream per row (020 satisfied on export side).
- tasks/submission.py already routes device observations to OSM/DeFlock (SIG-CONTRIB-004) + test test_tasks_submission.py::test_device_observation_is_routed_not_captured (004 DONE in P16.1).
- No existing §7 leverage metric module.
- Stage-0 outreach 012/012a/013 realized via connectors CompactStatus/sources.toml (charter/ingest phases); 019 records-request link is P10.3/out-of-scope.

## Plan (design)
New module `tasks/contribution.py` (pure data, MapRoulette cooperative-challenge object model):
- SIG-CONTRIB-016e: CHANGESET_HASHTAG constant; every SIG-originated suggestion carries it as checkin_comment; validation.
- SIG-CONTRIB-014/015/015a/015b: CooperativeChallenge + TagSuggestion; cooperative_type="tags"; NO automated-write path; only apply_by_mapper(account, decision) records a human step; AutomatedOsmWriteError on any programmatic write; MapperDecision {ACCEPTED,REJECTED,EDITED}; applied_by must be a mapper, never SIG. MapRoulette field crosswalk (checkinComment/checkinSource/instruction/...). 015b: record MapRoulette API doc + account-holder disclosure in activity data.
- SIG-CONTRIB-016f: contribution-path licence gate — build_suggestion() calls policy gate before rendering; incompatible source blocked (ContributionLicenceBlocked), no task rendered.
- SIG-CONTRIB-016e + §7/§32.6: LeverageLedger — count SIG-originated operator-attribution suggestions accepted upstream, keyed on the hashtag (reads accepted changesets bearing CHANGESET_HASHTAG).
- SIG-CONTRIB-018: PROJECT_CHANNELS registry — per-project correction export format using each project's own submission channel (not invented).
- SIG-CONTRIB-016d/016g + SIG-LIC-007a/b/c: OrganisedEditingActivity loaded from tasks/data/organised_editing.toml; discloses org+contact, hashtag, goal, timeframe, tools+data-sources+usage-conditions(+licence), participating accounts, metrics(task outcomes not rankings), registered flag. Governance page docs/governance/organised-editing-activity.md renders/registers it.

Policy: policy/licensing.py add permits_osm_contribution(record, target="ODbL-1.0") + assert_contribution_permitted (raises ContributionGateClosed). Block if UNDETERMINED or not derivative_permitted or target not in relicensable_to(effective_license).

API: add ClaimResponse.attribution: list[Attribution]; populate in /claim route from store.rights_for((c.source_id,)). (SIG-CONTRIB-020)

ADR-017 (repo ADR-055): the OSM automated-edits compliance analysis + contribution-back architecture (SIG-CONTRIB-016/016a/016b/016c).

- [ ] AC7 upstream attribution appears in API response AND export, not only About page (020) [det]
- [ ] AC8 phase-gate: CI green; new reqs tested; ADR; traceability + risk register updated
